_note: Descriptions of the columns of the principal tables, for Section 5.9.2 (table -> column -> description). The table names, column names and data types come from the running data model; this file only supplies the wording. A column without a line here gets its humanised name, and the script lists it.

program.name: Full program name
program.college: Academic cluster the program belongs to
program.has_practicum: Whether the program requires a practicum

student.student_number: Institutional student number, from the import or entered with the student
student.entry_year: Year the student entered the program
student.academic_year_entry: Academic year of entry as recorded in the workbook or entered in the monitoring sheet
student.standing: Standing: Active, On Leave, AWOL or Withdrawn
student.enrollment_tag: Enrollment state for the active term
student.risk_level: Red-Amber-Green risk state, or Not Yet Assessed
student.monitoring_new_student: Whether the student first appeared in the latest import or was added by hand
student.monitoring_upload_id: Reference to the import that produced this record, where there was one

user_account.password_hash: Salted hash of the password; never the password itself
user_account.student_id: Reference to the student, for student accounts
user_account.faculty_id: Reference to the faculty member, for faculty accounts
user_account.active: Whether the account may sign in
user_account.must_change_password: Whether the account must choose its own password before doing anything else (set for generated initial passwords)

course.title: Subject title
course.recommended_term: Term in which the subject is normally taken

curriculum_offering.program_id: Program for which the subject is offered
curriculum_offering.assigned_faculty_id: Faculty member assigned to handle the subject

course_record.status: Subject status, for example Planned, Enrolled, Completed, Dropped, Withdrawn or INC
course_record.term_label: Term in which the subject was taken
course_record.evidence_reference: Reference to the source of the value
course_record.grade_value: Reported grade value where supplied by import; the portal never writes a grade
course_record.grade_status: Outcome as reported, such as Passed, Failed, Incomplete
course_record.remarks: Free-text remarks recorded with a status change
course_record.source: Origin of the value: Manual entry when typed in the monitoring sheet (otherwise left to the import or the workflow that set it)
course_record.source_user: Person who made the manual entry
course_record.source_at: When the manual entry was made
course_record.source_reason: Reason given for the manual entry
course_record.removed_at: When a manually removed subject row was removed
course_record.removed_status: Status the row held when it was removed

withdrawal_application.effective_term: Term in which the withdrawal takes effect
withdrawal_application.subject_enrollment_id: The specific enrolled subject being withdrawn from
withdrawal_application.withdrawal_scope: Scope of the withdrawal; subject-level in this implementation
withdrawal_application.request_attachment_id: Reference to the student's letter of request
withdrawal_application.proof_attachment_id: Reference to supporting proof attached by the student
withdrawal_application.fee_status: Fee status recorded by staff (Not Applicable at filing: the fee tier is shown for information and the Business Office settles any payment)
withdrawal_application.requirement_status: Whether the required documents are complete (Not Applicable at filing)
withdrawal_application.staff_remarks: Remarks recorded by Graduate School staff
withdrawal_application.academic_coordinator_remarks: Remarks recorded by the Academic Coordinator
withdrawal_application.registrar_status: State of the handoff to the Registrar
withdrawal_application.registrar_reference: Reference recorded for the Registrar handoff
withdrawal_application.registrar_report_generated_at: When the Registrar document was generated
withdrawal_application.registrar_sent_at: When the document was recorded as sent
withdrawal_application.registrar_confirmed_at: When the Registrar's confirmation was recorded
withdrawal_application.completed_at: When the subject was tagged as withdrawn

practicum_record.moa_status: State of the memorandum of agreement
practicum_record.moa_uploaded: Whether a memorandum has been uploaded
practicum_record.practicum_site: Establishment at which hours are served
practicum_record.required_hours: Hours required by the program (set in the business rules)
practicum_record.completed_hours: Hours completed, as entered by the student as a running total
practicum_record.certificate_count: Number of certificate submissions, counted by the system
practicum_record.completion_status: Whether the practicum is complete (hours incomplete, or complete)
practicum_record.certificate_attachment_id: Reference to the latest submitted certificate
practicum_record.report_sent_at: When the status report was sent to the Dean
practicum_record.dean_reviewed_at: When the Dean marked the report reviewed

graduation_endorsement.review_window: Review window (school year) the candidate belongs to
graduation_endorsement.batch_name: Endorsement batch the candidate is processed in
graduation_endorsement.registrar_status: State of the handoff to the Registrar
graduation_endorsement.request_attachment_id: Reference to the signed application document
graduation_endorsement.registrar_received_at: When receipt by the Registrar was recorded (held for a future confirmation step)

research_case.title: Research title
research_case.status: State of the case at that gate

faculty.id: Unique identifier for the faculty member
faculty.name: Faculty name
faculty.specialization: Declared area of specialization (the expertise records add to it)
faculty.eligible_roles: Panel roles the faculty member may take
faculty.active: Whether the record is in use
faculty.google_calendar_id: Identifier of the connected Google Calendar
faculty.google_calendar_email: Google account of the connected calendar
faculty.google_calendar_access_token: Calendar access credential, held against this faculty record only
faculty.google_calendar_refresh_token: Calendar refresh credential, held against this faculty record only
faculty.google_calendar_connected_at: When the faculty member connected the calendar

schedule_request.student_id: Student whose defense is being scheduled
schedule_request.preferred_date: Date of the booking (start of the range)
schedule_request.preferred_end_date: End of the requested date range
schedule_request.status: State of the scheduling request (for example Scheduled, Deferred, Cancelled, Needs Re-confirmation)
schedule_request.matched_count: Number of panel members matched to the slot
schedule_request.panel_snapshot: Panel composition recorded at scheduling time
schedule_request.required_forms_status: Whether the required forms are complete
schedule_request.conflict_reason: Why a slot could not be confirmed, or the reason for a hold or cancellation
schedule_request.rescheduled_from_id: Earlier request that this booking replaces, so the history is kept
schedule_request.change_reason: Reason recorded for a reschedule or cancellation
schedule_request.requested_by: Who asked for the booking or the change
schedule_request.override_reason: Reason recorded when the lead-time warning was overridden
schedule_request.manuscript_received_on: Date the panel received the manuscript, from which the lead time is counted

task.title: What must be done next
task.owner_role: Role responsible for the next action
task.due_at: Date by which the action is due

transaction_log.id: Unique identifier for the log entry
transaction_log.transaction_slug: Process to which the action belongs
transaction_log.visibility: Whether the entry is internal or visible to the student
transaction_log.actor_role: Role under which the action was performed
transaction_log.source_reference: Reference to the source document or record
transaction_log.next_owner: Role that holds the next action
transaction_log.reflected_in_aims: Whether the change has been carried across to the official record
transaction_log.reflected_at: When it was marked as carried across
